surface_mechanism: 87:15 joins remembrance or voiced mention, the divine name, lordship, and prescribed prayer as one devotional sequence.

87:18-19 anchors that valuation in earlier written revelation associated with Abraham and Moses.
The basmala strengthens the divine-name, lordship, worship, mercy, and beneficence activations.
